title: 🔱 5-Minute Lord Shiva Tandava • Karthika Pournami Deepotsavam Special | 100% Non-Repeating 4K Motion
description:
🔱 BHAGAVAN SHIVA • MAHA ANANDA TANDAVA (THE SACRED COSMIC DANCE) 🔱

Experience 5 minutes of continuous, non-repeating realistic humanoid motion of Lord Shiva performing the supreme Ananda Tandava upon the sacred heights of Mount Kailash on the auspicious occasion of Karthika Pournami.

With every cosmic step and pulse of His Damru, negative energy dissolves and the universe is purified with auspicious peace and vitality.

✦ ──────────────────────── ✦
॥ श्री शिव ताण्डव स्तोत्रम् ॥
जटाटवीगलज्जलप्रवाहपावितस्थले
गलेऽवलम्ब्य लम्बितां भुजङ्गतुङ्गमालिकाम् ।
डमड्डमड्डमड्डमन्निनादवड्डमर्वयं
चकार चण्डताण्डवं तनोतु नः शिवः शिवम् ॥
